verdict.rationale: Intel's own marketing (docs-16) touts it as 'Intel's fastest desktop gaming processors,' implying leading single-thread/interactive performance, but independent reviews and community reports concretely contradict this: Tom's Hardware notes a 'generational regression in gaming performance' and AMD's 9950X coming out ahead in raw performance and perf-per-watt, and a widely-cited HN thread reports Windows-specific single-threaded performance instability ('performance consistency, especially with regards to single threaded performance') and games running at half FPS on certain OS builds. missing for 10: a dedicated independent single-thread benchmark suite (e.g., Cinebench 1T, Geekbench single-core) showing clear leadership, and resolution/acknowledgment of the Windows single-thread consistency issues.
